scope: STYNX neutral service, HTTP envelope, PostgreSQL and RLS sensors; DETRAN TEAT/BOAT route parity remains R-0022/R-0024

cases.consumerMapping: TEAT maps OFFLINE_SYNC_LEGACY_ITEM_NOT_APPLIED to TEAT.SYNC_LEGACY_ITEM_NOT_APPLIED; optional OfflineSyncLegacyItemIdentityResolver maps stable legacy identity across batches; HTTP routes/status/body bytes remain host-owned
host applier and OBX-compatible event port share one item transaction
host-owned conflict actions and handoff policy; legacy resolution names retain legacy semantics

adoptionMode.withoutPolicyResolver: E6 payload-hash dedup, second-cancel 409, 24h TTL, 100 items, published @Idempotent HTTP; requires 0002 before 1.5.0 PostgreSQL use
adoptionMode.withPolicyResolver: CTG9 durable identity, replay, lifecycle and policy; mode selected at bootstrap only

localProofPending: HTTP byte equivalence of legacy durable-store replay against published interceptor
consumerProofPending: TEAT before/after HTTP bytes and headers
BOAT before/after HTTP bytes and headers

upgradeBoundary.rule: 0002 is prerequisite for STYNX 1.5.0 in both E6 and CTG9 modes
upgradeBoundary.negativeSensor: integration/ctg9-upgrade.integration.spec.ts — 0001-only must raise OfflineSyncUpgradeRequiredError / OFFLINE_SYNC_UPGRADE_REQUIRED / 503 before DML or raw SQLSTATE 42703
